verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee offers Google SERP and Fast Search APIs that return result sets. It also has a separate HTML API that returns full page content, optionally as markdown via return_page_markdown. Nothing shows the two combined, so getting full content from search results takes a search call followed by separate scrape calls per result. missing for 10: a single-call search-plus-content endpoint, documentation of fetching full content for search results, independent or hands-on corroboration.
